versions.changelog:
- Added a skill to help creators list or claim their indie manga, webcomic, webtoon, light novel, or anime in the AnimeHunt directory.
- Supports self-published, webtoon-platform, Western, and AI-labelled works that other major databases refuse.
- Guides users through requirements, searching/claiming existing series, and preparing a listing.
- Highlights that AnimeHunt is a free discovery directory with external hosting; creators keep all rights.
- Provides relevant REST API endpoints for listing guidance and series searches.
